clips.title: The story
paras: Brave Windfeather sends you east from Red Cloud Mesa to face the raids on Mulgore. Sharptusk Thornmantle leads the Bristleback quilboar in Brambleblade Ravine, and his death could strike a hard blow against their attacks.

Red Cloud Mesa is home to young tauren learning the hunt and the ways of the Earth Mother. East of the mesa, Brambleblade Ravine lies in the hands of the Bristleback quilboar. They see the tauren as invaders taking sacred ground, and their skirmishes threaten the tribes trying to make a stable home in Mulgore.

The Bristleback attacks on Red Cloud Mesa follow the command of Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle. Deep in Brambleblade Ravine, he directs his warriors and geomancers against the Shu'halo from a fortified makeshift village. Brave Windfeather knows the raids will continue while Sharptusk lives. She sends you into the ravine to kill him and bring back his severed head as proof.

Brave Windfeather teaches that hunting an enemy who can hunt back tests more than skill. For young tauren and their allies, the hunt for Sharptusk demands courage, awareness, and discipline. His death brings justice for fallen kin and marks a hunter's readiness to travel across Mulgore's wider plains.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend - I have heard of you, newcomer. Perhaps it is you that will help us, where others have failed.

We traveler have carved a home out of this land, but not without a cost. The Bristleback quilboars of Brambleblade Ravine, led by Chief Sharptusk Thornmantle, have made our lives difficult with their continued war against us. I charge you to bring me the chief's head!
He will be found in the ravine to the east in their makeshift village.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Sharptusk will trouble us no more once you have brought me proof of his death. It is his head that I seek, friend.

We traveler live for the hunt, and there is no greater hunt than against one that is cunning enough to perhaps hunt us back. If you are successful in this task, young one, you will start to learn what I mean.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Justice has been served on this day by your swift actions, friend. Let this deed serve as a warning to all who would threaten our home.
You have earned this reward to help you on your sojourn, young adventurer.
